name: Tools of the Highborne
summary: Thundris Windweaver sends help from Auberdine to the ruins of Ameth'Aran. Restless Highborne spirits still carry enchanted relics through the shattered settlement, and he wants them taken away.

sections.title: Echoes in the Ruins
sections.body: South of Auberdine and east of the coastal highway, Ameth'Aran's stone foundations lie overgrown. Ten thousand years ago, the settlement was a stronghold of the Highborne, the privileged aristocracy of the ancient night elven empire. Their unchecked use of arcane magic helped bring about the Sundering, which shattered Ameth'Aran. The inhabitants never truly left. Sentinels patrolling Darkshore report that the Highborne ghosts still haunt the sunken plazas, clutching the enchanted tools and trinkets they held in life.

sections.title: Purging the Arcane Past
sections.body: For the kaldorei, arcane magic carries the memory of a danger that nearly destroyed life on Azeroth. Thundris Windweaver fears that leaving the Highborne implements in ghostly hands could invite corruption. He sends adventurers to wrest the relics from the restless spirits, intending to have them destroyed so their tainted magic cannot fuel another disaster.

faq.q: Where do I find the Highborne relics?
faq.answer: The relics lie in Ameth'Aran, south of Auberdine and east of Darkshore's main path. Wandering spirits in the ruined stone courtyards carry them.

aliases: who gives tools of the highborne
faq.answer: Thundris Windweaver is a night elf scholar and elder who lives in Auberdine. He works with the local Sentinels to protect Darkshore from lingering magical taints and ancient curses left by the Sundering.

faq.q: Why does Thundris want these relics destroyed?
aliases: purpose of tools of the highborne
faq.answer: Thundris fears the arcane power within the relics could awaken dormant evils. Night elf society rejects arcane magic because reckless Highborne sorcery caused the Great Sundering.

faq.q: What kind of spirits haunt Ameth'Aran?
faq.answer: The spirits are Highborne aristocrats who died during the War of the Ancients. They still cling to their pride, power, and magical artifacts, reenacting their faded lives among the ruins.

faq.q: Why are the Highborne still bound to the ruins?
faq.answer: Thundris does not know why the Highborne remain bound to Ameth'Aran. The Sentinels have told him only that the spirits persist among the ruins and still wield their ancient magical implements.

faq.q: What happens to the relics after you turn them in?
aliases: what does thundris do with relics
faq.answer: Thundris Windweaver takes custody of the relics and plans to dismantle and destroy them, so their dormant arcane taint can never be harnessed or released again.

angles.text: As a kaldorei, the ghosts of Ameth'Aran remind you of your ancestors' hubris and the Sundering that shattered their empire.
As a mage, you may recognize the relics as rare, pristine examples of Highborne craftsmanship from before the Sundering, even as the kaldorei seek to destroy them.
As a druid, you help clear corrupted arcane remnants from Ameth'Aran and ease the spiritual wounds disturbing Darkshore's natural tranquility.
As an Alliance member, you help the night elves secure their haunted lands and strengthen the Alliance's presence and solidarity in the ancient forests of northern Kalimdor.
